scheme_name: Upgrading the Skills and Training in Traditional Arts/Crafts for Development
other_conditions: Must belong to a minority community
Up to 25% of seats may be allocated to candidates from BPL families of non‑minority communities
3% of seats are reserved for differently abled persons belonging to minority communities
Upper age limit may be relaxed for differently abled persons belonging to minorities
Minimum qualification of at least Class V (may be relaxed for differently abled persons)
More than one member of a family can be eligible for training in the same art/craft form if each meets the eligibility criteria
benefits_summary: Free training in traditional arts or crafts with a stipend of ₹10,000 for non‑residential programmes or ₹13,000 for residential programmes, plus assistance in finding employment after training.
application_link: Candidates must contact the nearest Project Implementing Agency (PIA).
